mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, signaling an economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), a monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5% and rises by >0.1pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a housing market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 2000 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals monetary tightening causing economic distress, which reduces corporate investment and profit growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise in the same month, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth demand regime (GDPC1 annualized growth > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces economic momentum, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0% and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.
